source_notes: Soviet/Russian equipment line, recalled from open references (Jane's-type figures, IISS Military Balance context). Epoch slot = entered_service per docs/05 (1:1950-59, 2:1960-69, 3:1970-79, 4:1980-89, 5:1990-2004, 6:2005-15, 7:2016+). Nulls are deliberate: {"designation": null, "note": ...} records why the role was empty. Faction specials per docs/08 denial identity: cruiser, ssbn, ballistic_launcher, ground_ew, electronic_attack, light_tank. Some entries sit one epoch later than strict entry year where the sim gates the role (noted in basis). Cross-faction: PLA epochs 1-4 derive from these systems (Type 59=T-54A, J-7=MiG-21); KP freezes at roughly this line's epoch 2-3. | 2026-08 normalization: measurement conventions per data/factions/CONVENTIONS.md (aircraft mass=MTOW; combat-aircraft range=combat radius with attested ferry kept in ferry_range_km; support-aircraft range=max unrefuelled range; helicopter len=fuselage with rotor_diameter_m separate and width=max airframe width; tank len=gun-forward; ship and submarine height=draught; submarine mass=submerged displacement; towed pieces carry null road range). Epoch boundaries follow the fielded-in-numbers policy (a system entering in the last ~year of an epoch sits where it was fielded in numbers); converted fields carry '| conv 2026-08' or '| audit 2026-08' notes in basis.
